slides.title: Text: abstract
body: This study examines the impact of generative AI tools on undergraduate design students' creative processes. Drawing on interviews with 42 students, findings suggest that while AI accelerates ideation, it may reduce the diversity of initial concepts. Participants reported greater confidence but also concerns about authorship. These results, though limited by sample size, indicate a need for pedagogical frameworks that integrate AI critically rather than prohibit it.

options: AI speeds up ideation but may reduce diversity of ideas.
